arm.name: Six-axis arm
arm.note: One source of truth. lab/kinematics.py and viewer/index.html both read this file, so Python and the 3D view always agree on where the gripper is. Each joint sits at `offset` from the previous joint (in that joint's frame) and turns about `axis`. With every angle at 0 the arm points straight forward along +x. `home` is the folded rest pose.

level.title: Reach · 2 motors
level.blurb: Shoulder and elbow only. Same problem as the 2-link arm worked by hand: target is (1, 1) from the shoulder, both links are 1 m.
